notes: 8PSK exp(j (2 pi k / 8 + pi / 8)) with k from the Gray code b0 4 + b1 2 + b2 (M40.1), one sample per symbol, through the symbol-spaced channel 1 + 0.2 e^(j0.7) z^-1 + 0.08 e^(-j1.9) z^-2 (channel: [lag, magnitude, phase]), turned by the carrier phase 0.25 rad, plus complex noise for Eb/N0 22 dB per transmitted symbol energy; equalize with 11 forward and 3 feedback taps (a decision feedback equalizer), mu_dd 0.02 (normalized), cma_symbols 0 (decision mode from the start) and the phase tracker at phase_bw 0.01; exact float32 model over the whole input in one call; weights are the final 14 weights (11 forward, 3 feedback), final_mse_bits, final_mode, final_phase and final_frequency_bits the final state; the generator asserts that every decision of the second half is the transmitted symbol delayed by 5 (symbol_errors_second_half) and that mse ends below 0.01; snr_db_guard compares with the float64 loop (D111)
